customManagers.description: OpenTofu CLI version passed to opentofu/setup-opentofu and gruntwork-io/terragrunt-action. The github-actions manager updates the action reference, never the version an action is told to install, so without this the toolchain the whole build runs on is unwatched.

Terragrunt CLI version, in both spellings the workflows use: the tg_version input to gruntwork-io/terragrunt-action, and the TERRAGRUNT_VERSION env the e2e job installs from directly. Straddles the run-all to run --all CLI change, so a drift here changes what every live leaf renders.
TFLint version passed to terraform-linters/setup-tflint. The lint gate runs at --minimum-failure-severity=notice, so a version change can add or drop a hard failure.
TFLint AWS ruleset pinned in .tflint-aws.hcl. tflint's own plugin block is not a manifest any built-in manager reads.

Python packages installed by a bare pip install in a workflow step — the workflow-security and YAML-parsing gates among them. No manifest exists for these, so the pin is invisible to every built-in manager. The pattern skips pip's own flags: `pip install --quiet x==y` is the same pin as `pip install x==y`, and a matcher that only knows the bare form leaves the flagged one unwatched while reading as coverage.
Language runtimes pinned in setup-* action inputs. These are the versions CI actually executes, distinct from the action that installs them.
Go toolchain pinned in actions/setup-go. e2e.sh builds the operator with it.

Kubernetes control-plane version the cluster component defaults to. EKS retires minors on a published schedule, so this is the pin with a deadline rather than merely an upgrade. Keyed on the `# k8s-version` marker so the match is one line, which is what makes it checkable.
